note: FNS Section 844 specifically addresses adding new members to retrospectively budgeted households under a two-month (monthly reporting) system. Massachusetts does not use monthly reporting or retrospective budgeting — it operates under Simplified Reporting with prospective budgeting for all SNAP households. The OLG covers adding new household members through prospective procedures on the 'Add a New Person as a SNAP Household Member' page (SNAP > Eligibility Requirements > Household Composition), including benefit effective dates, BEACON entry steps, and examples. The general principles (e.g., not including someone already participating in another household, using prospective procedures for new members) are addressed through MA's prospective framework. The retrospective-specific mechanics in FNS 844 — budget month vs. issuance month interactions, two-month processing timelines, and prospective vs. retrospective eligibility determinations for new members joining retrospectively budgeted households — are not covered in the OLG because they do not apply to Massachusetts's certification system.
